item.title: Man from Lancashire who attempted to travel to Somalia to join ISIS has been jailed.
item.description:

item.title: Two men jailed for stabbing a journalist in south London
item.description:

item.title: Luton man jailed for terrorism offences after banned documents found
item.description:
